stops.note: a title for a brave warrior among Turks and Mongols; Mongolian 'baatar', as in Ulaanbaatar, is the same word
the heroes of the epic songs called 'byliny', such as Ilya Muromets, are bogatyrs
Viktor Vasnetsov's 1898 painting of three bogatyrs made them an emblem of Russian folklore abroad

current_meaning: a hero of Russian epic poetry
